title: MK Flu-Pipe Nextflow parameters
description: Parameter schema for MK Flu-Pipe Nextflow v0.1.2.

input_dir.description: Folder containing input FASTQ or FASTQ.GZ files.

output_dir.description: Folder where pipeline outputs will be written.

seq_type.description: Input sequencing type. Use short for Illumina short reads or long for ONT reads.

seq_mode.description: Optional short-read filename pattern hint for sample discovery.

run_ivar.description: Run canonical iVar variant calling for short reads.

run_medaka.description: Run canonical Medaka variant calling for long reads.

adapter_fasta.description: Optional adapter FASTA for fastp. Leave empty to use paired-end adapter detection.

min_len_short.description: Minimum read length retained by fastp for short reads.

min_len_long.description: Minimum read length retained by Filtlong for long reads.

max_len_long.description: Maximum long-read length retained by Filtlong. Use 0 to disable the upper limit.

min_qual.description: Minimum qualified base quality threshold used by fastp.

filtlong_min_mean_q.description: Optional minimum mean read quality for Filtlong.

min_coverage.description: Minimum coverage threshold used by assembly QC.

max_n_pct.description: Maximum allowed N percentage before QC warning/failure.

min_segments.description: Minimum number of Influenza segments expected for downstream reporting.

ivar_freq.description: Minimum allele frequency used by iVar.

coinfection_pct.description: Percent threshold used to flag possible coinfection or subtype mixing.

medaka_env.description: Medaka environment name retained for legacy compatibility.

gisaid_location.description: Location used to generate GISAID-ready outputs. Empty disables GISAID-ready files.

gisaid_year.description: Year used in GISAID-style isolate names.

metadata_csv.description: Optional CSV metadata file used for reporting and phylogenetic analyses. Required columns are sample_name and collection_date; optional location columns include country, state, city, and location.

run_phylogeny.description: Generate optional Augur phylogenies for HA and NA. Requires metadata_csv.

phylogeny_context_fasta.description: Optional FASTA of selected public context sequences from NCBI or manually downloaded GISAID data. Use with phylogeny_context_metadata.

phylogeny_context_metadata.description: Metadata CSV/TSV matching the context FASTA. Required fields for contextual records are strain, collection_date, type and segment; Flu A records also need subtype_HA or subtype_NA.

phylogeny_min_sequences.description: Minimum number of total sequences required before a HA or NA tree is generated.

phylogeny_threads.description: Maximum CPUs requested for Augur, MAFFT and IQ-TREE phylogenetic analysis.

run_legacy_bridge.description: Run the optional legacy Bash bridge.

legacy_script.description: Path to the legacy Bash script used only when run_legacy_bridge is true.

container_registry.description: Container registry namespace used by the ghcr profile.

container_tag.description: Container tag used by the ghcr profile, for example latest, v0.1.2, or sha-<commit>.

max_memory.description: Global memory cap per process, for example 24 GB.

queue_size.description: Maximum number of tasks submitted concurrently by the local executor.

fastp_timeout.description: Hard timeout in seconds for fastp tasks.

fastp_startup_timeout.description: Startup watchdog in seconds for fastp tasks.
